notes: Screens use the UI words (コース, 上達, 設定 and its sections as the Settings screen writes them). Please check: 「行く」「移動」 as ways to open a screen, 「速く / 早く」 and 「遅く / ゆっくり」, 「限界を探して」 for find-my-edge, and that 「た」 (past tense) in the not-a-command list reads right. Second reader: added 14 nearMissNone lines (past/progress, feelings, ways-to-ask, conditionals, wishes, verb + leftover) and 2 nearMissYours (録音して, コースをやめて); notCommand gained ながら, なる, なっ, なり, 方法, やり方, 仕方, ば, すると, たら, なら because 「ブルースを再生しながら練習する」 routed to play_exercise with the leftover as the name. Leftover-as-name is still possible for a statement with no such marker.
